subtopics.title: India-France Partnership
subtopics.summary: India and France upgraded their ties to a Special Global Strategic Partnership during the French President's visit. Cooperation spans defence manufacturing, technology, critical minerals, nuclear energy and trade. The 2026 India-France Year of Innovation and the Horizon 2047 roadmap set the course for future ties.
facts: Ties upgraded to Special Global Strategic Partnership during French President's visit
H125 helicopter final assembly line inaugurated at Vemagal, Karnataka (TATA-Airbus)
Joint venture of Bharat Electronics and Safran to produce HAMMER missile in India
2026 is the India-France Year of Innovation; India-France Innovation Network established
Joint declaration to secure diversified, resilient supply chains of critical minerals
Bilateral trade FY 2024-25: EUR 12.67 billion; France is 11th largest foreign investor in India
France is India's most frequent Republic Day Chief Guest (6th time)
India and France jointly constructing Jaitapur nuclear park in Maharashtra with EDF
Namaste France 2028 to celebrate 30 years of Strategic Partnership

subtopics.title: Chabahar Port and Arab League
subtopics.summary: Iran reaffirmed its commitment to Chabahar Port despite US sanctions uncertainty, and India Ports Global operates the port's terminals. The port gives India a route to Afghanistan and Central Asia that bypasses Pakistan. India and the Arab League also adopted the Delhi Declaration.
facts: Chabahar is Iran's only ocean-facing deep-water port, on the Makran Coast near the Strait of Hormuz
Chabahar is about 550 nautical miles from Gujarat's Kandla Port
Discussions on Indian participation began in 2002; formal recognition came in the 2003 New Delhi Declaration
India Ports Global assumed operational control of Chabahar Port in 2018
In 2024, India signed a 10-year contract to operate Shahid Beheshti and Shahid Kalantari terminals
Chabahar is an integral part of the International North-South Transport Corridor
Arab League was established in 1945 in Cairo; it has 22 members including Palestine
Arab States supply over 47% of India's crude oil imports
Over 9 million Indians reside and work in Arab League countries

subtopics.title: Malaysia and Seychelles Visits
subtopics.summary: The Prime Minister's visit to Malaysia produced a joint statement covering defence, digital and trade cooperation. Seychelles' President visited India to announce the SESEL joint vision, marking 50 years of diplomatic relations, along with a USD 175 million assistance package. Both visits stress disaster-resilient infrastructure, and the Seychelles visit also stresses maritime security.
facts: India and Malaysia set up a Strategic Affairs Working Group and a Su-30 Forum for air forces
Malaysia-India Digital Council formalised for fintech, AI, cybersecurity and e-governance
RBI and Bank Negara Malaysia to promote local currency settlement
Malaysia is India's 3rd largest trading partner in ASEAN
Harimau Shakti (5th Edition) is a joint military exercise with Malaysia
Malaysia formally acceded to the International Big Cat Alliance
SESEL: Joint Vision for Sustainability, Growth and Security through Enhanced Linkages
India announced a USD 175 million assistance package for Seychelles
Seychelles to become a full member of the Colombo Security Conclave
